question: Does the causal relative change in shipping NS ns_noise_rms_dbfs from the last prior ordinary-noise reference to the first pre-ready-speech disagreement align with the later post-NS local observation-domain noise-level change closely enough to justify one future parameter-free VAD noise-state alignment candidate?

causal_anchor_semantics.target: first oracle-speech disagreement frame with fewer than eight prior same-case ordinary-noise non-disagreement references
causal_anchor_semantics.anchor: last strictly prior same-case ordinary-noise non-disagreement reference

retrospective_benchmark_semantics.benchmark: median post_ns_rms_dbfs over the first eight strictly post-target ordinary-noise non-disagreement frames
retrospective_benchmark_semantics.role: retrospective fidelity benchmark only; never a causal input or refresh source

delta_alignment_hypothesis.primary_population: target cases with a first pre-ready-speech disagreement, at least one prior ordinary-noise causal anchor and eight strictly post-target ordinary-noise benchmark frames
delta_alignment_hypothesis.future_local_delta: later eight-frame median post_ns_rms_dbfs minus anchor post_ns_rms_dbfs
delta_alignment_hypothesis.primary_metric: absolute error between causal NS delta and future local-domain delta

diagnostic_outputs: per-case causal target and last-prior-reference anchor identity
anchor and target shipping NS ns_noise_rms_dbfs
anchor and target post-NS RMS dBFS
causal NS delta and future local-domain delta
global and per-noise-domain median/p90 delta fidelity

decision_contract.NS_VAD_CAUSAL_NOISE_DELTA_ALIGNMENT_DECO: Fresh target-only authority, causal anchor/target pairing, strictly post-target benchmark, coverage and shipping mirrors are valid. Report relative delta fidelity for review without selecting any source patch, normalization mapping, threshold or shipping candidate.
decision_contract.I033_INPUT_INVALID_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Dataset identity, fresh-seed identity, causal target count, anchor count/coverage, post-target benchmark coverage or shipping-mirror preconditions fail.

next_review: If and only if I033 passes the preregistered global relative-delta fidelity bounds with valid causal-anchor coverage, a new authority may test exactly one parameter-free VAD noise-state relative-alignment source candidate. Otherwise close this transfer path without threshold or mapping search.
